_why: Which VERSION strings are pre-releases under PEP 440, the one table the site (isPreRelease of src/lib/pep440.mjs) and the llms generator (scripts/generate_llms.py, packaging's Version.is_prerelease) are both tested against: a pre-release, alpha, beta or release candidate, or a development release, which pip installs only when asked to; a final or a post-release is not one.
